segments.an10.238:1.3: Aniccasaññā, anattasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, aṭṭhikasaññā, puḷavakasaññā [pulavakasaññā (sī.) puḷuvakasaññā (ka.)], vinīlakasaññā, vipubbakasaññā, vicchiddakasaññā, uddhumātakasaññā –
segments.an10.238:1.4: rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya ime dasa dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti. 239.
